items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We were talking when I would occasionally visit George and he introduced me to his good friend...

ctx.x: A number of years ago I got a chance to look at the original scores for that music after they found all this stuff not only for the Birth of the Cool band but for the Miles and Gil records. They found them in a warehouse in Philadelphia about fifteen years ago and they brought them up here and a friend of mine was working at King Brand Music and called me and said “come and look at all of this stuff” so I got to look at it one afternoon. There were actually a couple of George Russell scores for that band in there…
[Interview pauses so Konitz can adjust a lamp beside him]
